run.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CRWV)
run.summary: CoreWeave is a high-risk credit: contracted revenue is long and large, but principal debt of USD 35,551 million is 8.08x LTM adjusted EBITDA, free cash flow is deeply negative and funding depends on continued market access. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company non-GAAP), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal debt 35,551 and net debt 30,012 over LTM adjusted EBITDA 4,400. Period-end debt funds assets not yet earning revenue, and adjusted EBITDA adds back stock compensation; on operating income plus D&A the gross ratio is 9.46. Covenant leverage definitions are not supplied.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 4,400 over LTM cash interest 1,313 (869 plus 806 less 362). Over interest expense, net of 1,874 the ratio is 2.35. Covenant coverage definitions are not supplied.

cash.basis: Cash. Excludes restricted cash of 1380 and marketable securities of 15. Availability rebuilt as 1967 revolver (2500 capacity less 533 letters of credit), 385 DDTL 3.0, 5663 DDTL 4.0 and 1999 DDTL 5.0. Draws are tied to eligible asset purchases; DDTL 3.0 (draw period to July 2026) and DDTL 5.0 (to September 30, 2026) had passed their stated draw dates by the as-of date, and August 2026 draws are not reflected.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, guarantors, financing documents and third quarter 2026 data are not in the sources, so debt capacity and recovery mechanics cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels and headroom, guarantor identities and third quarter 2026 results are not in the sources, so debt capacity cannot be tested.
